label: Contrapunctus 3
title: The Art of Fugue, Contrapunctus 3, on the inverted subject

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a fourth every bar.
sections.leads: From D minor to A minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times).
sections.leads: From A minor to F major

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times). Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (4 times), in a sequence falling by a third every bar.
sections.leads: From F major to A minor

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1. Returns in Link (bar 62).
sections.leads: From A minor to G minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in G minor (Bass); Answer in D minor, ornamented (Alto); Subject in D minor, ornamented (Soprano)
Link
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 5 (bars 47–50) in part, with the tenor's line in the bass, a step higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: free counterpoint.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a third every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: free counterpoint.
